from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CapitalReserveRecord(BaseModel):
    """从一份公司财务报告中提取的资本公积记录，用于跨公司比较。"""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="公司名称，从文档标题或表头获取")
    capital_reserve_amount: float | None = Field(description="资本公积的具体金额数值，用于比较大小")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="金额的单位，如'元'、'CNY'等，确保可比性")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="报告期末日期，如'2024年3月31日'")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="文档中该指标的行标签原文，如'资本公积'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    capital_reserve_records: list[CapitalReserveRecord]
